close_reason: Already documented: backend.rs:220-228 explains 65536 default with memory sizing context and multi-tenant rationale.
description: email.rs defines COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS = 65_536 and includes a comment explaining the memory math: 65536 IDs x ~32 bytes each is ~2 MiB, which is acceptable. Total is also omitted when the result was capped (the 'only honest' comment at line 631). A future contributor might remove the cap (OOM risk on large accounts), raise it without recalculating memory cost, or unconditionally include total even when it would misrepresent a truncated result. Both the cap value and the conditional total omission are intentional.
title: COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS cap with documented memory sizing
